'''Indrani Bose''' (born 15 August 1951) is an Indian physicist, senior Professor at Department of Physics, [[Bose Institute]], [[Kolkata]]. Her fields of specialization are in theoretical [[condensed matter]], [[quantum information theory]], [[statistical physics]], [[biological physics]] and systems.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Bose|first1=Indrani|title=Affiliation, Research Interest|url=http://www.boseinst.ernet.in/indrani/indraniresearch.html|accessdate=11 October 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303185433/http://www.boseinst.ernet.in/indrani/indraniresearch.html|archive-date=3 March 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref>

== Education ==
Bose obtained her Ph.D. (Physics) in 1981 from [[Rajabazar Science College]], [[University of Calcutta]].{{citation needed|date=August 2022}}

== Career ==
Bose's research interests include the problem of quantum many body systems, quantum information theory, statistical mechanics and systems biology.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://boseinst.ernet.in/indrani/|title=Dr. Indrani Bose - Bose Institute, Kolkata|website=boseinst.ernet.in|access-date=2016-08-03|archive-date=13 August 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160813154449/http://www.boseinst.ernet.in/indrani/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

She is a fellow of the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]], [[Bangalore]]<ref name="Fellow profile">{{Cite web |url=http://www.ias.ac.in/describe/fellow/Bose,_Prof._Indrani |title=Fellow profile |date=2016 |publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences |access-date=12 November 2016}}</ref> and of the [[National Academy of Sciences]], [[Allahabad]].<ref name="NASI fellows">{{Cite web |url=http://www.nasi.org.in/Year%20Book%202015.pdf |title=NASI fellows |date=2016 |publisher=National Academy of Sciences, India |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150806211716/http://www.nasi.org.in/Year%20Book%202015.pdf |archive-date=2015-08-06 }}</ref> She also developed a strong solid-state theory group in the [[Bose Institute]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.streeshakti.com/Indrani-Bose.aspx|title=StreeShakti - The Parallel Force|website=www.streeshakti.com|access-date=2019-02-16|archive-date=28 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190428164113/http://streeshakti.com/Indrani-Bose.aspx|url-status=dead}}</ref>

== Awards ==
Bose was the first recipient of the Stree Shakthi Science Samman award (2000)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.streeshakti.com/Indrani-Bose.aspx|title=SSSS Award|last1=Bose|first1=Indrani|accessdate=11 October 2014|archive-date=28 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190428164113/http://streeshakti.com/Indrani-Bose.aspx|url-status=dead}}</ref> for her work on exact solutions of model [[Hamiltonian system|Hamiltonian]] (low dimensions) in the context of [[magnetic]] systems.
